item.title: Navigating Agent AI Standards: Foundations, Protocols, Competition, and Path to Convergence
item.description: As an AI and Agentic AI practitioner and enthusiast, I have watched the agentic AI space undergo a massive structural shift over the past year. We have moved rapidly past single LLM prompt wrappers into the era of autonomous, multi-agent systems. However, with this explosive growth has come an inevitable wave of standardizations, acronyms, and governing foundations. If you look at the landscape today, you are confronted with a plethora of open-source initiatives and projects: Agentic AI Foundation, AGNTCY, Linux Foundation-hosted projects such as A2A, BeeAI, Agent Skills by Anthropic, and new entrants like Agent Plugins by Google.
